lines.text: Deterrence means knowing what you're deterring - and here's the other half of your afternoon in 1952. Unknown propulsion means unknown wreckage. You shoot down something flying physics you can't name, and what lands isn't a laboratory. It might be a crater. It might be a material nobody can handle. It might be an incident that starts a war, because every other country sees a missile fired at something they've seen too. Every general who thinks about this for five minutes lands in the same place: capture the data, not the target. The shooting part's easy. Living with what comes down is the hard part.
